scope: Portable block-64 NF4 weights, optional nested block-256 statistics, BF16 reconstruction; no CUDA execution or memory-placement policy in this helper.

small_cases.result: Exact packed weights, statistics and BF16 bytes, including signed zero and partial blocks.

limitations: Not connected to runtime Gemma loading; production and packaged candidate still use BF16 weights.
404 reconstructed BF16 values differ across four of 336 projection matrices; complete quantizer equivalence is not established.
CUDA reduction emulation matches the captured RTX 3090 Ti cases; other GPU geometries need live verification.
Native compressed GPU storage/matmul, Quanto fallback, memory policy and full encoder arithmetic remain open.

full_encoder_comparison.scope: Native reconstructed BF16 weights versus actual CUDA BNB NF4 dequantization for every language-model projection matrix. Differences remain; a separate CUDA reduction-order emulation is being checked.
